document: ĐẶC TẢ YÊU CẦU CHỨC NĂNG - NHẬT KÝ NGƯỜI DÙNG (v0.3 - Châu Tuấn)

expectedRecordSchema.userId: UUID string of actor (FR-01 - Required for user actions)
expectedRecordSchema.action: Action enum string (FR-03 - e.g. CASH_VOUCHER_CREATE, CASH_VOUCHER_UPDATE, CASH_VOUCHER_VOID, PAYMENT, DEBT_PAYMENT, VOID_PAYMENT, ADJUST_PAYMENT_AMOUNT, CHANGE_PAYMENT_METHOD, REFUND, DEPOSIT_ADD, ADJUST_DEPOSIT, CREATE, UPDATE, CANCEL, RBAC_VIOLATION, GUEST_LIST_VIEW, GUEST_SEARCH)
expectedRecordSchema.entityType: Object type string (FR-04 - CashVoucher, Bill, Payment, Reservation, Booking, CityLedgerInvoice, Company, User, Guest, Authorization)
expectedRecordSchema.oldValues: Object containing ONLY changed fields with their previous values; null for CREATE events (FR-06, FR-07, FR-BIZ-01, FR-BIZ-02, FR-BIZ-03, BR-03, BR-04)
expectedRecordSchema.newValues: Object containing ALL changed fields with their new values after save (FR-06, FR-07, FR-10, FR-BIZ-02, AC-02, AC-03); sensitive fields (password, OTP, phone/CCCD in guest search) MUST be masked/excluded (BR-07, AC-07, AC-08, AC-13)
